name: Diprenorphine
summary: Diprenorphine, also known as diprenorfin and sold under the brand name Revivon, is a non-selective, high-affinity, weak partial agonist of the μ- (MOR), κ- (KOR), and δ-opioid receptor (DOR) (with equal affinity) which is used in veterinary medicine as an opioid antagonist.

pharmacology.text: Diprenorphine, also known as diprenorfin and sold under the brand name Revivon, is a non-selective, high-affinity, weak partial agonist of the μ- (MOR), κ- (KOR), and δ-opioid receptor (DOR) (with equal affinity) which is used in veterinary medicine as an opioid antagonist. Diprenorphine was the preferred reversal for etorphine but today naltrexone is preferred due to being a full antagonist.

uses.text: Diprenorphine, also known as diprenorfin and sold under the brand name Revivon, is a non-selective, high-affinity, weak partial agonist of the μ- (MOR), κ- (KOR), and δ-opioid receptor (DOR) (with equal affinity) which is used in veterinary medicine as an opioid antagonist. The drug is not approved for use in humans.

summaryZh: 地利洛非也稱為二丙諾啡，是μ-，κ-和δ-阿片受體（三者具有相同的親和力）的非選擇性，高親和力，弱部分激動劑，同時在獸醫學中用作阿片類拮抗劑。它用於逆轉超強效阿片類鎮痛藥的作用，例如用於鎮靜大型動物的埃托啡和卡芬太尼。該藥物未被批准用於人類。

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about its effects in people, as it is a veterinary drug. Because it blocks opioid receptors, it could bring on sudden withdrawal in someone dependent on opioids, and as a weak partial agonist it may cause mild opioid effects such as sedation.
sideEffects.zh: 地利洛非是獸醫用藥，對它在人體的影響所知極少。由於它會阻斷鴉片受體，可能讓對鴉片類藥物有依賴的人突然出現戒斷症狀；它也是微弱的部分致效劑，可能帶來輕微的鴉片類作用，例如鎮靜。
sideEffects.zhHans: 地利洛非是兽医用药，对它在人体的影响所知极少。由于它会阻断鸦片受体，可能让对鸦片类药物有依赖的人突然出现戒断症状；它也是微弱的部分致效剂，可能带来轻微的鸦片类作用，例如镇静。

fact.en: Diprenorphine is the antidote used by vets to reverse etorphine, an opioid so strong that it is used to immobilise elephants and rhinos. A radioactive form of it is also used in brain scans to map opioid receptors.
fact.zh: 地利洛非是獸醫用來逆轉埃托啡作用的解藥，埃托啡是一種強到可用來麻醉大象與犀牛的鴉片類藥物。它的放射性標記形式也被用於腦部掃描，以描繪鴉片受體的分布。
fact.zhHans: 地利洛非是兽医用来逆转埃托啡作用的解药，埃托啡是一种强到可用来麻醉大象与犀牛的鸦片类药物。它的放射性标记形式也被用于脑部扫描，以描绘鸦片受体的分布。
